generalOverview.title: General Overview
generalOverview.content: Motorove is a digital platform and mobile application designed to enhance the motorcycle experience by enabling users to discover, plan, record, and share motorcycle routes, join group rides, find nearby services, and engage with the motorcycling community. Users contribute to the platform by uploading routes, events, and relevant content. Motorove respects and complies with applicable data protection laws. Users retain control over what personal data is shared publicly or with other users.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By registering for or using Motorove (the "Platform"), users confirm they have read, understood, and agree to these Terms of Service ("Terms"). Access to any features of the Platform is conditional on the acceptance of these Terms. The English version of these Terms is legally binding. These Terms govern use of the Platform across all channels, including mobile apps (iOS & Android) and any subdomains of motorove.app. Motorove may amend these Terms at any time. The latest version will always be available on the website and shown during registration and in-app.

scopeOfServices.title: Scope of Services
scopeOfServices.content: Motorove provides users with: Route discovery and planning, GPS ride tracking and route recording, group ride creation and participation, social sharing of motorcycle-related activities, reviews, ratings, and media sharing, access to motorcycle-relevant services and locations, notifications and live updates, optional offline map downloads, and optional premium membership with added features. Users acknowledge that Motorove does not guarantee uninterrupted service or accuracy of third-party data (e.g., weather forecasts, traffic data, map coverage). Users are solely responsible for their actions on the Platform, including ride planning, route selection, and ride safety.

userRegistration.title: User Registration
userRegistration.content: Users may register for free via the mobile app or web interface. A test mode may be available with limited functionality. Only natural persons are permitted to register. Business accounts require prior approval. Users must be at least 18 years old or have verified parental/legal guardian consent. A single user may only register one account. Duplicate or impersonating accounts will be removed. Upon registration, users are enrolled in a free Basic membership, which provides core functionality. Users may upgrade to a paid Motorove PRO membership to access extended features. Registration requires a valid email address and password or third-party authentication (e.g., Google or Apple ID). Users must provide accurate information and update it as necessary. Motorove is not responsible for verifying user identity. Motorove reserves the right to suspend or delete accounts at its sole discretion.

paidMembership.title: Paid Membership (PRO)
paidMembership.content: Upgrading to PRO requires prior registration. PRO may be purchased through app stores (Apple or Google) or on the Motorove website (via secure payment provider, e.g., Stripe). PRO subscriptions may be monthly or annual. Prices and terms are clearly shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before renewal. Cancellation stops future charges but does not refund the current billing cycle. A 14-day free trial may be offered once per user. Cancellation during the trial incurs no charge. Users are responsible for any fees arising from failed payments. PRO users are subject to the same general Terms as Basic users, unless stated otherwise.

platformConduct.title: Platform Conduct & Content
platformConduct.content: Users agree not to post illegal, abusive, defamatory, discriminatory, or offensive content. Users must not infringe on third-party rights. All uploaded content must either belong to the user or be used with appropriate permissions. Users retain ownership of their content but grant Motorove a worldwide, non-exclusive license to use, display, and distribute such content within the app. Motorove reserves the right to moderate, remove, or block any content or user account in case of violations. Users must not access or attempt to access data of other users without authorization. The sharing of personal information is voluntary. Motorove is not liable for misuse of user-shared data. Users are solely responsible for saving a backup of their uploaded or recorded data.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: Users may delete their account at any time via the app or website. Deletion is permanent. Motorove may terminate or suspend accounts that violate these Terms or legal regulations.

limitation.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: Motorove provides the Platform "as is." No warranties are given for uninterrupted service, data accuracy, or feature availability. Users assume all risks related to riding, route usage, and interactions with others. Motorove is not liable for accidents, route errors, or data inaccuracies. Motorove disclaims liability for third-party services, embedded content, or user-shared information.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.content: The collection, processing, and storage of user data is governed by the Motorove Privacy Policy. By using the Platform, users consent to the terms of the Privacy Policy.

modifications.title: Modifications
modifications.content: Motorove reserves the right to update these Terms and the Privacy Policy. Users will be notified in-app or via email. Continued use of the Platform after changes implies acceptance.

governing.title: Governing Law
governing.content: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye. Any legal disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Istanbul. If any part of these Terms is found to be invalid, the rest remains enforceable.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions about these Terms, contact us at: media@motorove.app

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Motorove ("Motorove", "we", "our", or "us") is committed to safeguarding your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal data. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, process, store, share, and protect the data you provide while using the Motorove mobile application, website, and related services (collectively, the "Services"). By accessing or using the Motorove app or services, you agree to the practices outlined in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with this policy, you should not use our Services.

scope.title: Scope of Policy
scope.content: This policy applies to data we collect via: The Motorove mobile application, our official website, and all features, tools, and services provided through the app (e.g., route sharing, ride recording, group activities).

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect two types of data:

items.item1: Full name, username, email address, phone number
items.item2: Profile photo, city/region, motorcycle type, gender, riding experience (optional)
items.item5: Ride and route activity (e.g., shared routes, reviews, group ride participation)
items.item6: Subscription and billing information (if using premium features)

usageData.title: b) Non-Personal Data
usageData.content: App usage logs (e.g., time of access, feature usage), device identifiers (model, OS version, unique ID), aggregated analytics data, and IP address and browser type (if using web features).

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUse.content: We use the data we collect to:

items.item1: Provide core functionality (route creation, ride logging, social features)
items.item3: Process payments (via third-party services like Stripe or RevenueCat)
items.item4: Improve the performance, reliability, and usability of the app
items.item5: Communicate with you (e.g., notifications, service updates, support)
items.item6: Ensure safety, prevent abuse or fraud

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services & Integrations
thirdParty.content: Motorove uses third-party services for: Analytics (Google Firebase, Amplitude, Microsoft App Center), Payment Processing (Stripe, RevenueCat - we do not store card data), Maps & Navigation (Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Mapbox), Crash/Error Tracking (Sentry, Crashlytics). These services may collect anonymized or pseudonymized data under their own privacy policies. We ensure all integrations comply with GDPR and other relevant legislation.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with: Service providers (e.g., analytics, hosting, customer support), authorities when required by law or to prevent fraud or abuse, and other users (e.g., if you choose to publish a route, event, or post).

userPrivacy.title: User Privacy Settings
userPrivacy.content: You can control visibility of your: Profile and profile data, routes and rides (public, friends only, private), group membership and posts, and location tracking during rides (opt-in only). You may delete your account or request data deletion via the app or by emailing media@motorove.app.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.content: Our website and app may use cookies and similar technologies for: Session management, user experience personalization, and usage analytics. You may disable cookies in your browser settings.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Motorove is not intended for users under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we become aware of such collection, we will delete the data immediately.

dataRetention.title: Data Storage & Security
dataRetention.content: Data is stored securely in encrypted databases (EU or compliant data centers). We follow industry-standard security practices. No method of storage or transmission is 100% secure.

yourRights.title: Your Rights (Under GDPR and Similar Laws)

items.item3: Delete your account and associated data
items.item5: File a complaint with your local Data Protection Authority

yourRights.contact: To exercise your rights, contact: media@motorove.app

changes.title: Policy Updates
changes.content: We may update this policy to reflect changes to our practices or legal requirements. Updated versions will be posted in-app or on our website. Continued use of the app after such updates implies consent.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For any questions, concerns, or data-related requests: Motorove, Email: media@motorove.app. Only the English version of this policy is binding.
